Scope
- Edit only the files the brief names. If another file must change, stop and say which and why.
- Never ask the user questions. If blocked, report what blocks and what you tried. Do not wait on background work: finish or report.

Branch and push
- Branch from origin/main unless the brief says otherwise. Own CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/<task>/. Scratch there too, never /tmp.
- Rust 1.99.1 on PATH (/Users/gabe/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.1-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin) for builds; commits need MISE_RUST_VERSION=1.99.1 (the mise shim forces 1.98.1). Caveat: with the toolchain bin first on PATH `rust-objcopy` can fail and strip silently does nothing; irrelevant unless you measure binary size.
- Signed commits ending `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_013R2ytvK9B32ZaSUaSe6aAZ`. Push normally (`git push origin HEAD:<branch>`), never --no-verify, verify the remote SHA with `git ls-remote`. Do not open or edit the PR, do not poll CI.

Checks: targeted, CI runs the rest
- Always, before push: `just lint doc-check machete typos` (fast).
- Then only what your change touches: Rust -> nextest of the touched crates; types/output/merge -> `just test-checker-lane` once; checker/session code -> gate_harness determinism and memory modes; output-preserving change -> full-content diff (JSON parsed, `stats` dropped) of `extract --json --quiet --no-cache` vs a build of origin/main on ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/gate-large/src and ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/checker-default/chakra-only/src (tools: ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/perf-analysis/same.py, identity.sh; ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/final-perf/ab.sh interleaves two binaries).
- Do NOT run deny, semver, test-ts, test-napi, test-integration, test-py unless you changed those areas: CI runs them on every PR.
- Tests that fail on base for every behavior change. No oracle runs, no corpus fetches. No new scripts, options or recipes. Changeset only if `just semver` demands one.
- No wall-clock timing unless the brief asks; check `uptime`, and prefer allocation or instruction counts (load-independent).

Cap
- Stop and report after the call cap in the brief (default 60 tool calls) with what you have verified. Listing something as 'not done' with its cause beats burning more calls.

Artifacts (agents to agents; humans see them at the edge)

Pre-push gate (the reviewer must find nothing new; read ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/findings-synthesis.md, classes C1-C8)

#!/bin/zsh
# First (empty cache) vs second (cache kept) run of caliper alone, checker on, addon config; plus --no-checker (empty cache).
# usage: first-second.sh <bin> <runs> <corpus>...   prints one line per run: corpus kind run wall_s rss_mib bytes load1
bin=$1; runs=$2; shift 2
base=/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/corpora
out=/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/oracle-run/fs
mkdir -p $out
typeset -A SRC
SRC=(chakra chakra-ui/packages/react/src mantine mantine/packages/@mantine/core/src antd ant-design/components shadcn shadcn-ui/apps/v4 spectrum react-spectrum/packages)
one() { # corpus kind run cache args...
  local c=$1 k=$2 r=$3 cache=$4; shift 4
  local load=$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg | awk '{print $2}')
  /usr/bin/time -l -o $out/time.txt $bin extract --src $base/$SRC[$c] --json --load-dependencies --collapse-inherited-props dependencies --cache-dir $cache "$@" > $out/$c.$k.json 2>$out/$c.$k.err
  local rc=$?
  local t="$(cat $out/time.txt)
exit $rc"
  local real=$(echo "$t" | awk '/ real / {print $1}'); local rss=$(echo "$t" | awk '/maximum resident/ {printf "%d", $1/1048576}')
  local ex=$(echo "$t" | awk '/^exit/ {print $2}')
  echo "$c $k $r $real $rss $(stat -f %z $out/$c.$k.json) load=$load exit=$ex"
}
for c in "$@"; do
  for r in $(seq $runs); do
    cache=$out/cache-$c; rm -rf $cache; mkdir -p $cache
    one $c first $r $cache
    one $c second $r $cache
    nc=$out/cache-nc-$c; rm -rf $nc; mkdir -p $nc
    one $c structural $r $nc --no-checker
  done
done

# caliper measurement at origin/main de016f69 (2026-11-15)

SHA `de016f69c3b021aaf3223420faf7866087ded864` (merge of #483; binary reports 0.11.0, unreleased main). `git fetch` was blocked in the worker's sandbox, so this is the last fetched origin/main. The machine was shared with other agents: the 1-minute load average stayed 5 to 10 during every timed step, so every timing is inflated. Memory and sizes are not affected. Written by the lead from the measurement worker's report; the raw files are in this directory (`weekly.json`, `weekly.md`, `issue.md`, `logs/`, `fs/`, `work/`, `sb-demo/`).

## Summary

- First run (empty cache, checker on, addon config): Chakra 3.50 s / 1,908 MiB, Mantine 1.06 s / 857 MiB, antd 1.49 s / 1,072 MiB, shadcn 1.41 s / 981 MiB, Spectrum 1.56 s / 840 MiB. 1.4x (Mantine, Spectrum) to 6.4x (Chakra) faster than react-docgen-typescript (RDT). All five within the budgets (`weekly.py --enforce-budgets` exit 0).
- Second run (kept checker answer): Chakra 0.77 s / 476 MiB, Mantine 0.27 s, antd 0.08 s, shadcn 0.42 s, Spectrum 0.23 s: 5.6x to 29x faster than RDT. Structural floor (`--no-checker`) 0.07 to 0.49 s.
- Quality (share of the props of reported components the checker confirms): shadcn 98.7%, antd 93.0%, Spectrum 88.4%, Mantine 32.7% (62.9% not judged, 0 wrong). Wrong props: shadcn 0, antd 1, Spectrum 7, Mantine 0. Chakra: not measured, the oracle died of a Node heap OOM.
- Storybook dev mode, cold (browser, demo Button over Chakra ButtonProps): structural Controls 891 ms after the story renders, the checker replaces them in place 134 ms later. Warm: 128 to 156 ms after render, already the checker's answer. A live props edit shows its row in 172 ms. Dev-server node process 893 MiB.
- Worse than expected: (1) the demo Button shows 437 Controls rows, not about 146: about 300 are @types/react DOM, ARIA and event props and about 130 are Chakra condition props (`_active`, `2xl`...); a plain `ComponentProps<'span'>` component shows 280 rows. (2) RDT recall of @types/react props in the CLI output is very low with the checker on: Mantine 0.4%, Chakra about 0%, shadcn 4.9%, antd 23.9% (0.10.0 without the checker: 99% or more). (3) The weekly oracle cannot run Chakra on Node's default heap. (4) 63% of Mantine's oracle verdicts are "not judged".

## CLI per corpus: first vs second run (Caliper alone)

Median of 3 runs under `/usr/bin/time -l`. Command: `extract --src SRC --json --load-dependencies --collapse-inherited-props dependencies --cache-dir DIR`; first run with an empty DIR, second with DIR kept; structural adds `--no-checker` with an empty DIR. RDT is the weekly's single run (it keeps no cache). Load was 5.7 to 9.1.

| Corpus | First | Second | Structural | RDT | Ratio first / second | JSON size (structural) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chakra (`packages/react/src`) | 3.50 s / 1,908 MiB | 0.77 s / 476 MiB | 0.49 s / 364 MiB | 22.5 s / 2,847 MiB | 6.4x / 29x | 49.6 MB (6.9 MB) |
| Mantine core | 1.06 s / 857 MiB | 0.27 s / 370 MiB | 0.11 s / 181 MiB | 1.50 s / 549 MiB | 1.4x / 5.6x | 57.2 MB (6.1 MB) |
| antd | 1.49 s / 1,072 MiB | 0.08 s / 129 MiB | 0.07 s / 143 MiB | 2.21 s / 1,056 MiB | 1.5x / 28x | 4.6 MB (3.7 MB) |
| shadcn (`apps/v4`) | 1.41 s / 981 MiB | 0.42 s / 308 MiB | 0.29 s / 351 MiB | 3.83 s / 1,593 MiB | 2.7x / 9.1x | 5.5 MB (8.0 MB) |
| Spectrum (`packages`) | 1.56 s / 840 MiB | 0.23 s / 207 MiB | 0.16 s / 238 MiB | 2.21 s / 867 MiB | 1.4x / 9.6x | 13.4 MB (7.3 MB) |

The weekly's own numbers agree (parse caches warm, only the kept answer removed): Chakra 3,497 ms / 1,876 MiB and 761 ms; Mantine 1,069 ms / 853 MiB and 266 ms; antd 1,447 ms / 1,060 MiB and 93 ms; shadcn 1,427 ms / 954 MiB and 430 ms; Spectrum 1,562 ms / 820 MiB and 232 ms. react-docgen took 0.7 to 2.4 s and 209 to 617 MiB.

Budgets (time, memory), all pass: Chakra 3.5 of 18 s and 1,876 of 14,336 MiB; Mantine 1.07 of 4 s and 853 of 2,048 MiB; antd 1.45 of 6 s and 1,060 of 2,048 MiB; shadcn 1.43 of 5.6 s and 954 of 2,048 MiB; Spectrum 1.56 of 6.8 s and 820 of 2,048 MiB.

## Quality

Headline from the oracle (universe v5, checker on):

| Corpus | Components / props | Correct | Less precise | Wrong | No checker type | Not judged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mantine | 332 / 20,148 | 32.7% | 4.3% | 0 | 8 | 62.9% |
| shadcn | 1,552 / 13,932 | 98.7% | 37 | 0 | 54 | 0.7% |
| antd | 210 / 4,127 | 93.0% | 2.1% | 1 | 0 | 4.9% |
| Spectrum | 1,032 / 17,016 | 88.4% | 20 | 7 | 238 | 10.1% |
| Chakra (rerun with a 16 GB Node heap, exit 0) | 620 / 486,834 | 16.7% (81,451) | 7.8% (37,951) | 0 | n/a | 75.5% (367,432) |

On the same Chakra props RDT has 10 wrong and 96.8% of the props it lists agree with the checker. Chakra's share confirmed correct was 99.995% on 0.10.0 (no checker): the drop is almost all "not judged" (as on Mantine, 0 wrong both times). Cause not found; a likely one is that types cut to their name by the size bound (PR 468) cannot be compared. The weekly's oracle step needs `REDACTED` for Chakra (it dies at about 4 GB).

Against the same checker, RDT's wrong count is 9 props on shadcn and 0 elsewhere.

Recall vs RDT (collapse `none`, as the weekly measures it):

| Corpus | Components | Own props | @types/react props |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mantine | 328/368 (89.1%) | 19,756/19,756 | 283/70,665 (0.4%) |
| Chakra | 614/664 (92.5%) | 485,975/485,975 | 1/167,353 |
| shadcn | 1,527/1,573 (97.1%) | 13,567/13,677 (99.2%) | 16,042/330,268 (4.9%) |

| Spectrum | 1,080/1,105 (97.7%) | 16,357/16,359 | 12,973/14,940 (86.8%) |

Collapse, `dependencies` (the addon default) vs `none`: Chakra median props per component 139 vs 844; Chakra's own `Button` lists 146 props plus one `SystemProperties` layer of 705 names, vs 851 props with `none`. Mantine (72), antd (14), shadcn (2) and Spectrum (11) have the same median either way. With `--no-checker` the medians are larger (Chakra 415, Mantine 348, shadcn 280): the checker output drops the DOM props the structural pass lists, which is the same recall drop as above.

## Storybook dev mode

Setup: the harness copies live-demo (storybook 11.0.0-beta.0, vite 8.3.8) into `sb-demo/`; `caliper-docgen-storybook` symlinked to this SHA's `packages/storybook`; napi binding built from this SHA. Options: `semanticWaitMs: 1`, `prefetchStories: 0`. A Playwright sampler polls the Controls rows every 10 ms; times are ms after navigation start. Load 5 to 8, and the Chakra oracle rerun was using one core throughout. Server start to ready 4.93 s (including npx and Vite re-optimizing).

| Case | Story rendered | Controls | Checker answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cold server and cache, Button first visit | 889 ms | 1,780 ms, 437 rows, structural (+891 ms after render) | 1,914 ms in place (+134 ms) |
| Same server, Button second visit | 828 ms | 956 ms, checker's answer directly (+128 ms) | n/a |
| Same server, Badge first visit | 834 ms | 971 ms (+137 ms), 280 rows | n/a |
| Same server, Card first visit | 909 ms | 1,065 ms (+156 ms), 418 rows | n/a |
| Restart with cache kept, Button (edited before the restart: not a pure cache hit) | 889 ms | 1,264 ms, structural (+375 ms) | 1,370 ms (+106 ms) |
| Restart with cache kept, Input first visit | 895 ms | 1,040 ms (+145 ms), 445 rows | n/a |

Live edit: adding `fresh?: 'x' | 'y'` to Button's props with the page open showed the new radio row 172 ms after the file write. Memory: the Storybook node process 893 MiB RSS, plus esbuild 16 + 61 MiB and the npm wrapper 92 MiB; no separate checker process. Row content: the collapsed `SystemProperties` layer does not appear as rows (no `bg`, `p`, `m`), but the DOM and condition props do. The roughly 146 figure was not reproduced. Versus the earlier 0.11.0 demo: rows 1,141 to 437; structural-to-checker swap 154 ms to 134 ms.

## vs 0.11.0

No stored 0.11.0 weekly record exists (the CI weekly of 2026-11-15, run 43686845177, died with exit 143 on "chakra: Caliper"; the last green record is 2026-11-09, 0.10.0 with `--no-checker` on a GitHub runner, not comparable). From docs/measurement.md (0.11 plus the PR 468 fix): Chakra then 4.5 s / 6.9 GB, now 3.5 s / 1.9 GB (time -22%, memory -72%); the other four within 0.1 s and 0.05 GB. 0.11.0 as released needed 42 GB on Chakra. Headline vs 0.10.0 (older universe, no checker): Mantine 93.6% to 32.7% (the gap is "not judged"; 0 wrong both times), shadcn 94.2% to 98.7%, antd 94.2% to 93.0%, Spectrum 83.8% to 88.4% (1,032 components vs 454).

## What failed or was not measured

- Chakra oracle: OOM at the default Node heap (log tail in `logs/weekly.log`); a rerun with `REDACTED` was unfinished at hand-back.
- A quiet machine was never reached (load 5 to 10).
- Neighbour vs distant story with prefetch: not measured. antd in Storybook: Vite fails with `Failed to resolve import "./version"` (generated file). No big Mantine or antd story measured. Not recorded: warm-restart ready time, RDT's dev-server cost, a Badge screenshot.
- Cold run clears only Caliper's cache directory; the OS file cache was warm.
- Not diagnosed: the @types/react recall drop and the 437 rows. Both look like checker-mode output omitting or not collapsing DOM props (ADR 0028 "ambient" props); not checked whether that is intended.

Build (Rust 1.99.1 first on PATH): `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=oracle-run/target cargo build --release --locked -p caliper-docgen`; `pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile`; napi: `pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-napi build:napi` with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=oracle-run/target-napi`, then `pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-storybook build`. Weekly (`run-weekly.sh`, load 8.59 at start): `scripts/weekly.py --bin oracle-run/target/release/caliper-docgen --corpora caliper-fixtures/corpora --work oracle-run/work --runs 2 --oracle --enforce-budgets --previous weekly-2026-11-09/weekly/weekly.json --out oracle-run/weekly.json --markdown oracle-run/weekly.md --issue oracle-run/issue.md`. First/second runs: `run-fs.sh` calling `first-second.sh BIN 3 chakra mantine antd shadcn spectrum`. Storybook: `sb-demo/serve.sh LOG cold`; setup in `sb-demo/setup-stories.sh`.

# First (empty cache) vs second (cache kept) run of caliper alone, checker on, addon config; plus --no-checker (empty cache).
# usage: first-second.sh <bin> <runs> <corpus>...   prints one line per run: corpus kind run wall_s rss_mib bytes load1
bin=$1; runs=$2; shift 2
base=/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/corpora
out=/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/oracle-run/fs
mkdir -p $out
typeset -A SRC
SRC=(chakra chakra-ui/packages/react/src mantine mantine/packages/@mantine/core/src antd ant-design/components shadcn shadcn-ui/apps/v4 spectrum react-spectrum/packages)
one() { # corpus kind run cache args...
  local c=$1 k=$2 r=$3 cache=$4; shift 4
  local load=$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg | awk '{print $2}')
  /usr/bin/time -l -o $out/time.txt $bin extract --src $base/$SRC[$c] --json --load-dependencies --collapse-inherited-props dependencies --cache-dir $cache "$@" > $out/$c.$k.json 2>$out/$c.$k.err
  local rc=$?
  local t="$(cat $out/time.txt)
exit $rc"
  local real=$(echo "$t" | awk '/ real / {print $1}'); local rss=$(echo "$t" | awk '/maximum resident/ {printf "%d", $1/1048576}')
  local ex=$(echo "$t" | awk '/^exit/ {print $2}')
  echo "$c $k $r $real $rss $(stat -f %z $out/$c.$k.json) load=$load exit=$ex"
}
for c in "$@"; do
  for r in $(seq $runs); do
    cache=$out/cache-$c; rm -rf $cache; mkdir -p $cache
    one $c first $r $cache
    one $c second $r $cache
    nc=$out/cache-nc-$c; rm -rf $nc; mkdir -p $nc
    one $c structural $r $nc --no-checker
  done
done

# Chakra whole-project extract: 42 GB with the checker on

Date: 2026-11-15. Binary: release-candidate-target/release/caliper-docgen (0.11.0, main 7b8f6d0d). Corpus: corpora/chakra-ui/packages/react/src.

## Summary

- The 42 GB is the Rust heap of the converter's output types (`PropType` trees), not the tsrs checker arenas. mimalloc stats at exit: peak commit 43.5 GiB in mimalloc's own arenas (tsrs arenas are a separate `mmap` range, `tsrs_core-0.24.0/src/reserve.rs:86`), with peak RSS 40.4 GiB, so almost all of it is mimalloc-allocated Rust memory.
- Why it is so large: in this corpus Chakra's style system (`styled-system/`) is *project source*, so `is_own` (crates/semantic/src/convert.rs:339) treats its ~700 `SystemProperties` and its 130 `Conditions` as the project's own members, and `MAX_FIELDS` never cuts own members (convert.rs:1249, "What the project declared itself is never cut"). Every `_hover`, `sm`, `css`, ... prop (type `SystemStyleObject`) expands to about 700 fields × (value union + a 130-field condition object): 24.7 MB of JSON *each*. In the gate fixture (`checker-default/chakra-only`) the same types come from `node_modules`, are a dependency's, and stop at a named boundary, so the gates never saw this.
- The multiplier: `Converter::convert` returns `entry.converted.clone()` on every memo hit (convert.rs:681-686), a deep clone of the tree, and `PropType` has no shared children. The run made 1,729,385 memo hits against 74,401 misses (`type_memo=(1729385, 74401)` in the `-vv` log). Output is 3.87 GB of JSON, and memory is about 10 times that.
- Why the guard missed it: the arena guard (`max_rss_mib`, 768 MiB, `Upkeep::decide`) exists only in `OnDemand` (crates/semantic/src/on_demand.rs:491, 646, 656), which serves the Storybook/watch session. `extract` calls the one-shot `resolve_cached_early`/`resolve_early`/`resolve` (crates/cli/src/commands/extract.rs:187-190, crates/semantic/src/lib.rs:159-208), which has no memory check. Even if it were wired in, it reads only the tsrs arena range with `mincore` (crates/semantic/src/checker.rs:164-171), which leaves out the converter heap where the 40 GB lives. It also checks only between requests, and the first parallel batch of 5 components alone built 39 GB in 5 s.
- Recommended bound (two parts):
  - A size cut in the converter: a converted type larger than a byte or node budget becomes a named `Truncated`. Prototyped with a 256 KB budget: Chakra goes from 41.8 GB / 14.8 s / 3.87 GB output to 4.36 GB / 4.8 s / 108 MB, and the output is byte-identical (stats excluded) on Mantine core and on the gate fixture.
  - A hard heap budget on the one-shot path as the safety net: past it, the remaining components keep their structural answer, with one warning diagnostic.
  - Sharing memo results (no deep clone) is the follow-up that removes the remaining ~40× ratio of memory to output.

## 1. Reproduction and where the memory lives

- Default (checker on, fresh `--cache-dir`): exit 0, 14.84 s real, 29.9 s user, max RSS 43,413,766,144 B, peak footprint 41,844,472,552 B (39.0 GiB).
- mimalloc (`MIMALLOC_SHOW_STATS=1`): arenas reserved peak 44.3 GiB, committed peak 43.5 GiB, purged 40.8 GiB, peak rss 40.4 GiB, 45 threads peak.
- RSS samples (0.3 s apart, MiB): 171, 583, 785, 1041, 4741, 11330, 17862, 23984, 30197, 34850, 35902, 37681, 39231, 39905, then flat at about 40 GB for about 7 s, a bump to 41.3 GB at the end (kept-answer save and JSON write), then a slow decline. The climb is the first 4 s of checker work.
- `--no-cache -vv` (no kept answer): footprint 41,847,880,472 B, the same. So the kept answer is not the cause. Phase log:
  - Program built in 61 ms.
  - The first 5 components (`ArrowDownIcon`, `AspectRatio`, `AccordionItem`, `ActionBarCloseTrigger`, `Badge`) each took about 5,080 ms and about 7,100 checker requests. RSS went from 1 GB to 39 GB over exactly those 5 s.
  - Every later component took 2 to 650 ms, served from the memo.
  - The backend finished at total_ms=7366 with `type_memo=(1729385, 74401)`.
- Ruled out:
  - tsrs arenas: they are a separate mmap range, and mimalloc's commit alone accounts for the RSS.
  - JSON writer: it streams through a 64 KiB `BufWriter` (extract.rs:82), and the RSS plateau comes before writing.
  - Kept answer: `--no-cache` peaks the same. It does add a transient copy, because `kept::save` builds the whole 2.16 GB msgpack in one `Vec` before writing (crates/semantic/src/kept.rs:332-339), so `checker-answers.msgpack` is 2,155 MB on disk.
- `--no-checker`: 0.2 s, 385 MiB (the caller's number, not re-run).

## 2. Counts and what in Chakra makes it this size

- Components: 629 extracted, 620 resolved by the checker, 9 kept structural (not exported), 3 props degraded.
- Interned prop entries in the output `props` table: 3,708. Prop references in the components' `props` arrays: 4,432 (at most 16 per component; the style props sit in the props table and inherited layers).
- Output JSON: 3,870,036,382 bytes. Component section: 514 KB. Props table: 3.869 GB. Diagnostics: about 0.3 MB.
- Size distribution of props: median 759 B, p90 152 KB, p99 24.7 MB. 151 props over 1 MB hold 3.72 GB (96%); 574 more are between 100 KB and 1 MB.
  - About 125 condition and breakpoint props (`_hover`, `_focus`, `_peerChecked`, `sm`, `mdToXl`, `2xlOnly`, `base`, `css`, `styles`, ...) of type `SystemStyleObject` = `Nested<SystemProperties & CssVarProperties>` (styled-system/css.types.ts:57): 24.68 MB each.
  - 8 slot props (`rootProps`, `startAddonProps`, `endAddonProps`, `startElementProps`, `endElementProps`, `branchProps`, `branchContentProps`, `children`) of about 45.5 MB each, which embed the style props.
  - `rowStart`/`colSpan`/... 9 MB, `placement` 17 MB, `direction` 12 MB.
- Source shapes:
  - styled-system/generated/system.gen.ts: 793 lines, 706 optional properties.
  - conditions.gen.ts: `Conditions` with 130 keys.
  - Each style property is `ConditionalValue<V>` (css.types.ts:32), which includes a `{ [K in keyof Conditions]?: ... }` object of 130 fields, each a depth-truncated text.
  - So one `SystemStyleObject` is about 706 × (literal union + 130 fields), and each of about 125 props holds its own copy.
- `--collapse-inherited-props none` (the weekly) does not change this. With the 256 KB prototype the weekly flags gave the same 108 MB output and 4.33 GB as the default. The weekly's extra cost on 0.11.0 (31.8 s, 42.7 GB) is the same blow-up.
- In the gate fixture (chakra-only, 787 components), the largest prop is 26 KB: there `@chakra-ui/react`'s style system is a dependency, so `SystemStyleObject` stays a name.

## 3. Why the arena guard did not bound it

- The bound exists only in `OnDemand`:
  - `DEFAULT_MAX_RSS_MIB = 768` (on_demand.rs:71).
  - It is checked in `warm` (on_demand.rs:491) and in `maintain` after each served request (on_demand.rs:643-652, gated by `Upkeep::checks_memory(self.served)`).
  - `stop_past_bound` (on_demand.rs:655-669) turns the checker off for the session.
  - `OnDemand` is used by the Storybook provider, the watch path and the binding, not by `extract`.
- `extract` takes `Pass::Extract` and uses `Teardown::OneShot` (extract.rs:181), then calls `resolve_cached_early`, `resolve_early` or `resolve` (extract.rs:187-190, lib.rs:159-208). None of them reads memory or carries a `max_rss_mib`.
- What the guard measures: `arena_mib()` runs `mincore` over `tsrs_core::reserve::base()..RESERVE` (checker.rs:164-171). That is the checker's nodes, symbols and types only. The converter's `PropType` trees, the memo (`State::memo`, convert.rs:495), `KeptProps`, `PartsSeen` and the merged `ParsedProp`s are all mimalloc heap, outside that range. A 768 MiB arena bound would read a few hundred MiB here while the process held 40 GB.
- When it checks: between requests. The 39 GB is built inside the first concurrent batch of 5 components (about 5 s), so a per-request check is too late even in `OnDemand`. A Storybook session opening one of those 5 components would build the same multi-GB tree before any check.
- The ADR 0026 memory gate measured `chakra-only` (dependency style system, 785 MiB) and the arena, so neither the fixture nor the metric could see a project-source style system.

## 4. Proposed bound

Part A: the size cut in the converter (keeps semantic answers, bounds output).
- Rule: in `Converter::convert` (convert.rs:674-700), after `uncached`, a converted type whose size passes a budget is replaced by `Truncated` with its name (`self.truncated`, convert.rs:953), and the memo stores the cut form. Measure the size as a node count kept alongside the memo entry, rather than serializing as the prototype does.

1	#!/bin/zsh
2	# phases.sh <name>: phase marker times from the -vv log and RSS at/after them
3	d=/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/oracle-run/mem/runs
4	for n in "$@"; do
5	sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' $d/$n.log > $d/$n.clean
6	marks=$(awk '
7	 /opening it again/ && !a {print $1, "early-program-discarded"; a=1}
8	 /semantic program built/ && !b {print $1, "program-built"; b=1}
9	 /semantic component answered/ && !c {print $1, "first-component"; c=1}
10	 /semantic component answered/ {last=$1}
11	 /semantic backend finished/ {print last, "last-component"; print $1, "backend-finished"}
12	 /PHASE/ {print $1, $0}
...
16	echo "$marks" | while read t rest; do
17	  r=$(awk -v t=$t '$1<=t {r=$2} END{print r}' $d/$n.rss)
18	  echo "$t ms rss=${r}MiB $rest" | cut -c1-200
19	done
20	# RSS curve, every ~250 ms
21	awk '{ if ($1>=nx) {printf "%d:%d ", $1, $2; nx=$1+250} } END {print ""}' $d/$n.rss
22	rtk proxy grep -o -e 'peak rss: [0-9.]* [GM]iB, peak commit: [0-9.]* [GM]iB' $d/$n.clean
23	rtk proxy grep -o -e 'type_memo=[^ ]*' -e 'programs=[0-9]*' -e 'program_ms=[0-9]*' $d/$n.clean | sort | uniq -c
24	done

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# reads.py <reads-file> <project-root>: the checker's file reads by origin (scratch).
import os, re, sys, collections
path, root = sys.argv[1], os.path.realpath(sys.argv[2])
reads, exists = set(), set()
for line in open(path):
    m = re.match(r'(\w+)\("(.*)"\)', line.strip())
    if not m: continue
    kind, p = m.groups()
    if kind == 'ReadFile': reads.add(p)
    elif kind == 'FileExists': exists.add(p)
def pkg(p):
    parts = p.split('/node_modules/')[-1].split('/')
    return '/'.join(parts[:2]) if parts[0].startswith('@') else parts[0]
def origin(p):
    if '/node_modules/' not in p:
        if re.search(r'/lib\.[\w.]*d\.ts$', os.path.basename(p) and p): return 'ts-lib'
        return 'project' if os.path.realpath(p).startswith(root) or p.startswith(root) else 'other-source'
    k = pkg(p)
    if k == 'typescript': return 'ts-lib'
    if k.startswith('@types/'): return k
    return 'pkg:' + k
by = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
libs = []
for p in reads:
    try: size = os.path.getsize(p)
    except OSError: size = 0
    o = origin(p)
    by[o][0] += 1; by[o][1] += size
    if o == 'ts-lib' or 'lib.' in os.path.basename(p) and p.endswith('.d.ts') and '/node_modules/' not in p: libs.append((size, os.path.basename(p)))
missing = [p for p in exists if not os.path.exists(p)]
tot = sum(v[1] for v in by.values())
print(f"read files {len(reads)} bytes {tot/2**20:.1f} MiB; FileExists asked {len(exists)}, missing {len(missing)}")
groups = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
for o, (n, b) in by.items():
    g = 'project' if o in ('project', 'other-source') else 'ts-lib' if o == 'ts-lib' else '@types' if o.startswith('@types/') else 'other-pkgs'
    groups[g][0] += n; groups[g][1] += b
for g, (n, b) in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1][1]):
    print(f"  {g}: {n} files, {b/2**20:.2f} MiB ({100*b/max(tot,1):.0f}%)")
print("  @types:", ', '.join(f"{o[7:]} {n}/{b/2**20:.2f}MiB" for o, (n, b) in sorted(by.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1][1]) if o.startswith('@types/')))
print("  top pkgs:", ', '.join(f"{o[4:]} {n}/{b/2**20:.2f}MiB" for o, (n, b) in sorted(by.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1][1]) if o.startswith('pkg:'))[:900])
libs.sort(reverse=True)
print(f"  ts libs ({len(libs)}): " + ', '.join(f"{n} {s/1024:.0f}K" for s, n in libs[:8]))

# Memory profile: first run with the checker (2026-11-16)

These are scratch measurements only. Nothing was committed or pushed. Binaries:
- origin/main de016f69: `oracle-run/target/release/caliper-docgen`.
- Instrumented builds of de016f69 (`mem/target-main`) and of the PR 490 head 3eb7ec26 (`mem/target-pr490`).

Instrumentation (`mem/instrument.pl`, scratch copy only):
- `PHASE` markers print mimalloc `mi_process_info` (current RSS, peak RSS, commit) and the tsrs arena's resident MiB (`checker::arena_mib`).
- Environment switches: `CAL_PROGRAMS` (lanes), `CAL_TYPES` (compiler `types`), `CAL_BATCHES` (sequential root batches) and `CAL_READS_OUT` (dumps the kept answer's `reads`).

Command: `extract --json --load-dependencies --collapse-inherited-props dependencies --cache-dir <empty>`. Harness:
- `mem/prof.sh` runs it under `/usr/bin/time -l` and samples `ps` RSS every 50 ms.
- `mem/exp.sh` runs the experiments.
- Raw files are in `mem/runs/`, and `mem/exp.txt` and `mem/base.txt` hold the summaries.

Load was 8 to 20 throughout. Times are noisy; RSS is not. The uninstrumented and instrumented peaks agree within 2%: Chakra 1,866 to 1,910 MiB across 4 runs, shadcn 980 to 991, Mantine 860 to 871, sb-demo 230.

## 1. Peak RSS by phase (instrumented main, MiB = mimalloc current RSS at the marker)

| Phase (end of) | Chakra | shadcn | Mantine | sb-demo |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (a)+(b) structural pass incl. dependency declarations, `--no-checker` alone | 364* | 357 | 181* | n/a |
| (c) same point with the early checker program loading in parallel | 490 (arena 48) | 690 (arena 166) | 280 (arena 48) | 185 (arena 31) |
| (d1) all components answered and converted | 1,604 (arena 155) | 751 (arena 196) | 672 (arena 87) | 199 |
| (d2) generic instantiation (`instantiate::answer`): **the process peak is here in all four** | **1,866** | **982** | **868** | **230** |
| checker released, kept answer saved | 1,704 | 757 | 832 | 219 |
| (e) merge (`merge_semantic_in`: apply_props, relevance, layers) | 1,705 | 758 | 836 | 220 |
| (f) JSON written (streamed, 64 KiB BufWriter) | 1,715 (+10) | 760 (+2) | 869 (+33) | 222 |
| Peak (`time -l`) | 1,866 | 982 | 871 | 230 |

\* From REPORT.md (structural run).

What the checker loads (E1, from the kept answer's `reads`):
- Chakra: 2,291 files, 6.6 MiB. Of that, `@types/node` is 70 files and 2.4 MiB, csstype 0.86 MiB, and @ark-ui 918 files but 0.53 MiB. Project files are 226 (0.7 MiB). There were 3,748 failed lookups.
- shadcn: 5,165 files, 25.8 MiB. Project 1,231 files (6.2 MiB); lucide-react 1.9 MiB, next 363 files (1.7 MiB), @tabler/icons 1.3 MiB, date-fns 1.2 MiB, `@types/node` 2.2 MiB. There were 8,830 failed lookups.
- Mantine: 1,393 files, 6.3 MiB, of which `@types/node` is 2.4 MiB.
- sb-demo: 1,895 files, 3.1 MiB.
- No TypeScript `lib.*.d.ts` is read from disk: tsrs embeds them, so their size is not in these counts.
- The tsrs arena (nodes, symbols, types) is only 87 to 206 MiB at its peak.

Conclusion: the program that gets loaded (phase c) is small. The memory is the checker session's working set. That is the tsrs heap (type and relation caches, which live on mimalloc, not in the arena) plus the converter's memo and trees, all built in phase d.
- On Chakra, d1 adds 1,114 MiB. Most of it, 530 to 1,402 MiB, comes in the first second, while the 7 style-system components each make about 4,000 requests.
- The result is small by comparison. The kept answer (the serialized semantic outcome) is 32.5 / 9.0 / 23.4 / 1.9 MiB, and the second run peaks at 476 MiB on Chakra.
- So about 1.4 GiB of Chakra's peak is session state that the output does not need.
- Not separated: how much of d1 is tsrs heap and how much is converter heap. Both are mimalloc; there is no dhat feature or counting allocator.

## 2. PR 490 on shadcn (+22%): measured

| shadcn | main | PR 490 | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--no-checker` peak | 357 | 463 | **+106 (+30%)**, structural time 0.32 → 0.49 s |
| structural marker (checker run) | 690 (commit 863) | 810 (commit 990) | +120 |
| components answered (d1) | 751 | 999 | +248 |
| peak (d2) | 982 | 1,195 | +213 (+22%) |
| checker `batchRequests` / memo hits / misses | 4,265 / 17,076 / 8,060 | 4,087 / 10,909 / 6,959 | the checker does **less** work |
| `heap_peak_mib` (backend log) | 859 | 1,114 | +255 |

Cause:
- Caliper-side data, not checker work.
- About half (+106 MiB) is already in the structural pass. PR 490 adds `relevance: Option<Arc<Placement>>` to every component (`types/output.rs:143`, kept across merges) and the element layers' member lists. `InheritedLayer.members` is `Vec<String>` per component, not interned; only the JSON's `nameLists` are interned.
- The rest (about +130 MiB) appears during the component phase although checker requests fell. Likely cause: those placements and listings ride along in the targets that `session` clones per file. Not proven: no allocation profile.
- Chakra grows the same way, 1,866 → 2,030 (+164, +9%); Mantine 871 → 894.

## 3. Ranked savings (measured)

| # | Change | Chakra | shadcn | Effort / files | Risk | Dev server? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Generic instantiation builds a **second whole program**. `Rpc::layered` (rpc.rs:548) creates a fresh snapshot rooted at every root file plus the synthetic files, while both lane programs and their caches are still alive, and the peak lands there in all four. Fix: derive it from the live snapshot (`updateSnapshot`, as `beside` does), root it only at the generic components' files, or release lane 2 and its converter first. | bound **−262 (−14%)** | bound **−231 (−24%)** (Mantine −196, −23%; sb-demo −31) | M; lib.rs `session`, rpc.rs `layered`, instantiate.rs | Output-preserving by design; check with an identity diff | Likely yes, where a session answers a generic component (not measured) |
| 2 | Undo PR 490's retained data: no per-component `Arc<Placement>` after merge, interned or shared layer member lists | PR 490 −164 (−8%) | PR 490 **−213 (−18%)**; structural −106 | M; core relevance, output.rs, semantic targets | None to output if only storage changes | Yes: structural data lives in the session |
| 3 | Converter working set: share memo results (`Arc` subtrees, no deep clone on 812k memo hits vs 40k misses), and cut oversized types before expanding them, not after (chakra-memory.md Part C) | not measured; d1 is +1,114 MiB, about 870 of it in the first 1 s | d1 +61 | L; convert.rs, core `PropType`, serializers | Public type change (semver); output identical if done right | Yes |
| 4 | One checker lane (`CHECKER_PROGRAMS` 2 → 1) | −15 (−1%), time 3.8 → 6.3 s | −58 (−6%), 1.55 → 4.95 s | S; lib.rs | Identical output; much slower | Minor |
| 5 | Sequential root batches. 2 batches (b2) | −41 (−2%) | −6 | M (~60 lines; scratch `batched`) | b2 identical | No |
|   | b2 with one lane | −101 (−5%), 5.6 s | −50 (−5%) | | identical | |
|   | 4 or 8 batches | b4 −96 (−5%), 10.8 s; b8 +31 | b4 +8, b8 −20 | | **Output changes** (Chakra OPAQUE_TYPE 8 → 69, JSON 49.6 → 46.8 MB): a batch's program misses declarations other roots bring | rejected |
| 6 | E2 `types: ["react"]` | −12 (noise); reads 2,291 → 2,076 files, 6.6 → 3.6 MiB | +5 (noise); reads unchanged at 5,165 | S; rpc.rs `default_options` | Output identical on all three (0 changed props, so there are no examples) | No |
|   | Mantine with the same `types` setting | −13; reads 1,393 → 1,017 files, 6.3 → 3.4 MiB | | | | |
| 7 | mimalloc: `MIMALLOC_PURGE_DELAY=0`; `ARENA_EAGER_COMMIT=0` with a 64 MiB reserve | 1,887 / 1,867 vs 1,866 to 1,910 (0%) | 980 vs 982 (0%) | S | None | No |
| 8 | Streaming output: already streamed (`write_extraction_output_json` into a BufWriter) | written +10 | +2 (Mantine +33) | n/a | n/a | n/a |
| 9 | Free data before the next phase | Useless for the peak: the peak is before the merge and the process exits after writing | | | | |
| 10 | Early program reopened ("not the request's", 116 vs 113 roots) on Chakra and Mantine | memory not separated; about 70 ms | not seen | S | None | No |

E1 and E2 answer "can we narrow what the checker loads":
- The program is already only the roots' closure.
- Disk input is 3 to 26 MiB, and the TypeScript libs are embedded.
- Narrowing `types` drops `@types/node` (about 2.4 MiB of text) with no RSS or output change.
- Loading less is not where the memory is.

## 4. Recommendation

1. **#1, share or narrow the generic-instantiation program.** Measured bound: Chakra 1,866 → about 1,604 MiB; shadcn 982 → about 751; Mantine 868 → about 672.
2. **#2, before merging PR 490.** Its +164 to +213 MiB is all Caliper-side retained data. With #1, PR 490's shadcn goes from 1,195 to about 750 to 800 MiB.
3. **#3, shared memo results and an early size cut.** This is the only lever on Chakra's +1.1 GiB component phase. Its saving is not measured.

Expected with #1 and #2:
- Chakra 1.87 GiB (2.03 with PR 490) → about 1.6 GiB.
- shadcn 0.98 (1.2) → about 0.75 GiB.
- Getting below 1 GiB on Chakra needs #3.

Not measured:
- How d1 splits between the tsrs heap and the converter (no allocation profiler).
- The fix for #1 itself: the number above is a bound, peak minus the d1 marker.
- The Storybook dev server's 893 MiB.
- antd and Spectrum.
- `--collapse-inherited-props all`: a harness flag clash, so it was not run.
- A quiet machine (load 8 to 20; RSS is unaffected).
